cards.title: Sorting into ranges
cards.body: To sort a value into ranges, check one edge at a time. Because the first match wins, each elif needs only one comparison.

cards.title: Checking a range in one go
cards.body: Python can chain comparisons: `3 <= age <= 12` is True when age is from 3 to 12, both included.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: At exactly 18 o'clock it prints nothing at all. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `hour > 18` skips 18 itself. Use `else:` to catch everything left, or `hour >= 18`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 12 < 12 is False, so 12 goes to else. Edges are where < and <= differ, so test them.
